violations.description: AWS Access Key ID hardcoded directly in source file
violations.recommendation: Remove the key immediately, rotate it in AWS IAM, and use environment variables or AWS Secrets Manager instead. Add 'config/settings.py' to .gitignore if it contains local overrides.

violations.description: .env file with production secrets is tracked in version control
violations.evidence: File '.env' appears in git-tracked file listing — contains DATABASE_URL and API credentials.
violations.recommendation: Immediately remove .env from git history using 'git filter-repo' or BFG Repo Cleaner. Add '.env' to .gitignore. Rotate all credentials that were exposed.

violations.description: GitHub Action pinned to mutable 'main' branch ref instead of a commit SHA
violations.recommendation: Pin actions to an immutable commit SHA (e.g., uses: org/some-action@abc1234) to prevent supply-chain attacks from action maintainers pushing malicious code.

violations.description: Workflow uses 'permissions: write-all' granting unnecessary broad write access
violations.recommendation: Apply the principle of least privilege. Specify only the minimal required permissions (e.g., 'contents: read') and grant write only to specific scopes that require it.

violations.description: Production dependency 'flask' is unpinned — any version will be installed
violations.recommendation: Pin all production dependencies to exact versions (e.g., flask==3.0.3) and generate a lockfile. Use 'pip freeze > requirements.txt' or migrate to pyproject.toml with poetry.lock.

violations.description: node_modules/ directory committed to version control
violations.recommendation: Remove node_modules/ from git tracking: 'git rm -r --cached node_modules'. Add 'node_modules/' to .gitignore. Dependencies should be installed via 'npm install', not committed.

violations.description: macOS .DS_Store metadata file committed to repository
violations.evidence: File '.DS_Store' appears in git file listing.
violations.recommendation: Remove with 'git rm --cached .DS_Store' and add '.DS_Store' to .gitignore. Consider adding a global gitignore: git config --global core.excludesfile ~/.gitignore_global

violations.description: CI pipeline explicitly skips the test suite with '--co' (collect-only) flag
violations.recommendation: Remove the '--co' flag to actually execute tests. '--co' only collects but does not run them. A CI that skips tests provides no safety net.

violations.description: Repository has no LICENSE file — all code is implicitly 'All Rights Reserved'
violations.evidence: No LICENSE, LICENSE.md, or LICENSE.txt file found in repository root.
violations.recommendation: Add an appropriate open source license (e.g., MIT, Apache 2.0) to clarify usage rights. Without a license, contributors and users cannot legally use or contribute to the project.

violations.description: Hardcoded absolute OS-specific path to local development database file
violations.recommendation: Replace hardcoded paths with relative paths or environment variables: DB_PATH = os.environ.get('DB_PATH', 'data/dev.sqlite3'). This prevents failures on other developers' machines and in CI.
